videos.title: Hands On with Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold: Lighter, Better Screen, More Gemini
videos.description:
Google’s book-style foldable, the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, is still very expensive, but there are some upgrades that make it better than its predecessor. It comes in just two colors: Olive and Obsidian.

Durability matters a lot for foldables, so Google made the back out of a new glass composite that it claims is nearly impossible to break. There’s a new gearless hinge that protects the inner screen, which, by the way, also has a reduced crease.

videos.title: BIGGER Batteries in the New Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 and Watch 9
videos.description:
Alongside a new trio of Galaxy foldables, Samsung has also unveiled its Galaxy smartwatches with larger batteries at its Unpacked launch event in London.
